coordinate_system: source SVG coordinates, step 10 drawing units; not km or lat/lon
algorithm: Rasterize each currently visible fragment of source outer continents 1 and 4 separately using original coastline polygon intersection with V2.22 fracture polygon, without connecting pixels across cut-away seawater.

Use original three proposed ridge curves per source landmass. Shoreline cells receive proxy potential 0; compute inward multi-source Dijkstra cost with 8-neighbor links and extra crossing cost proportional to proximity to ridge traces.

A high-potential interior cell drains by following the stored strictly decreasing Dijkstra parent chain until the shoreline. Choose up to four sufficiently long separated headwater paths per fragment as illustrative streams.
Assign illustrative outlet-coast sector 0/1/2 based on the outlet along the source landmass long axis, NOT on measured watershed drainage or actual precipitation.
Do not infer true elevations, rainfall, lake formation or stream discharge. Source mask clipping means a candidate stream stays within a single land fragment by construction.
source_structural_restrictions: All R1/R2 and Tangxi are on the separate protected central mainland and are not touched.
No fragment is connected across the V2.22 rifts by runoff edges.
No claims of geological history, true mass runoff, measured DEM, climate or freshwater volume.
